title: Call for proposals: hosting the 27th IAHR-APD Congress in 2030
summary: Member institutions in the region are invited to submit hosting proposals to the Secretariat using the standard proposal format.
body:
Proposals should cover the venue and dates, the proposed theme and sub-themes, the local organising committee, the budget and registration model, and the arrangements for publishing proceedings.

The guidelines and the proposal format are available under [About the Division](/about/).
